name: intents_v7
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which of the support intents is the message about? Pick the single intent that best matches what the customer wants or is reporting.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card the customer has received: how to activate it, or activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum or maximum age to open or use an account; whether children or teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch wallet with the account, including topping up through them or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs: where the nearest ATM is or which ATMs accept the card.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The automatic top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer moved money into this account by bank transfer (for example from their own account at another bank, such as a UK account) or made a transfer, and it does not show in the balance yet, even if they also ask how long such transfers usually take.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: The customer deposited cash or a cheque but the money is not showing in the balance yet.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary, or the customer is told a transfer is not possible or not allowed (the bank will not permit it, often one that worked before).
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop, reverse or take back a transfer or transaction they already made (e.g. sent to the wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used: which merchants, businesses or places accept it.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, whether it can arrive by a date or be expedited, delivery to a country.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account or app, adding a card in the app, or making a found or new card show up and work in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The card does not work in general or across many places, with no single refused purchase at a merchant described (not contactless only, not an ATM-only issue).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Any fee or extra charge the customer links to using or paying with their card, including complaints about being charged fees on payments in general or wanting to know when fees apply to payments.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: The customer points to one or more payments or purchases on their statement that they did not make or do not recognise, even if they also suspect someone may have their card.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card purchase made in a foreign currency got the wrong exchange rate, or the customer asks what rate was applied to one of their own past transactions.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, ate or retained the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM; whether ATM withdrawals cost money.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make, even if they also suspect their card was copied or ask to freeze it.
criteria.change_pin: Changing the card PIN, including where or how it can be changed.
criteria.compromised_card: The customer still has the card (it is not lost or physically stolen) but believes its details were stolen or copied or that someone else is using it, and wants to secure, freeze or report it, without centring on particular unfamiliar payments.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank operates in or supports for customers.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment in a shop, restaurant or online was declined, rejected or refused, including a failed attempt to pay at a shop worded as the card not working there.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused or declined a cash withdrawal; cannot get cash out.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined by the bank.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Restrictions or limits of disposable virtual cards, such as how many times they can be used.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address or other account information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or charges for exchanging currency.
criteria.exchange_rate: General questions about what exchange rates the bank uses or where to see current rates, not about the rate applied to a past transaction of theirs.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange one currency into another using the app; whether a currency exchange is possible.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra amount or fee on the statement (such as an extra pound or a small unknown charge) that the customer does not tie to using their card, a transfer, an ATM or a currency exchange; a bare question about why they were charged.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer, or an attempted payment to another party that is not a card purchase (such as paying for a property), failed, gave an error, or keeps failing.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Obtaining a disposable (single-use) virtual card, or who is eligible for one.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card for an account, or finding or receiving the card PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional, second or spare card; how many cards one can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a virtual card, or where the virtual card is.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The physical card itself is lost, missing or was stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone was lost, stolen or left behind and they worry about account access or use.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, including cost of a new card and where it can be sent.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot or needs to reset the app passcode or login code.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase is still pending, or a payment (with no transfer named) has not gone through yet.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is shown as pending or in progress, including when the customer did not get the money they tried to take out and the transaction still shows as in progress.
criteria.pending_transfer: A specific transfer (the customer says transfer or sending money) is shown as pending, including asking how long it will stay pending, or the customer complains it is overdue or stuck (waited days, still not completed, had to wait long), including money someone else sent them that they cannot see yet.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN or card is blocked after entering the wrong PIN too many times.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money from other people, such as friends or salary payments.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer was expecting has not appeared in the account.
criteria.request_refund: Asks for a refund of a purchase, or how to be refunded by a merchant.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted, cancelled or returned to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card brands or types and which currencies are accepted for topping up.
criteria.terminate_account: Wants to close or delete the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card, including cards issued in other countries.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, or gave an error.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how many, how often.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was made and may have looked successful, but the money was then reversed, is not credited to the account, or later disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card, or problems where money went missing in a card top-up.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice or appears multiple times.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for making a transfer, or unexpected or increased fees for using the account abroad that are not tied to a card purchase, an ATM or a currency exchange.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to put money into the account: moving money in from another bank account, or which general methods exist to add money.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Money sent to someone has not been received by the recipient.
criteria.transfer_timing: Questions about how long a transfer takes or when it can be expected to arrive, when the customer does not say it is already pending, overdue or stuck, and does not say a transfer they made into their own account is missing from the balance.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Trying to verify identity but it fails or the app does not recognise them.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity and which documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Questions about the source of the customer's funds or where their money came from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for a top-up, including finding the verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work or was rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or choosing between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave less cash than requested or than was debited.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal abroad got the wrong exchange rate.
